title: Curious Otter in Retro Room
description: A large, detailed blue-green otter with expressive eyes and a slight smile holds a decorative circular medallion in its paw. The otter is positioned in a stylized retro living room featuring a mustard-yellow sofa, wooden side table with a lit lamp, lush green plants, and colorful patterned circular wall decorations.
prompt: A large teal otter with big sparkling eyes and white whiskers stands in the foreground, holding a small ornate circular medallion with plant designs. The background shows a cozy retro 1970s living room with a mustard yellow sofa, wooden credenza with a glowing lamp, large leafy plants, and walls decorated with multiple colorful circular patterned art pieces. Soft painterly style with vibrant colors and gentle gradients.
